caption: The drawing features a central urn-like object standing on a tall, round pedestal base. The vessel has a bulbous body that tapers downward and upward, a wide rim, and a domed lid with two cylindrical rods protruding vertically from its center. The pedestal stem is slender in the upper part and widens toward the round base, which is slightly stepped for stability. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, likely using pencil or ink, creating a shaded, realistic effect through stippling and hatching. The main object is enclosed within a large rectangular frame. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller inset sketch of the same object, depicted with minimal detail and labeled with scale indicators. The background is plain and unadorned, and a signature reading "Mo. Mangusotti" appears at the lower right of the main drawing.
